Name: Little Shed for Solid Foundations
Author: inmognito
Description:
From the modder who brought you the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12459]Tiny Greenhouse[/url], meet the Little Shed. 

[list]
[*]Smaller and cheaper than the regular sheds, perfect for fitting in those awkward corners
[*]Interior size of 7 by 6, allowing you to fit 29 kegs/chests/machines.
[*]Paintable exterior

[/list]
[b]Installation
[/b][list=1]
[*]Download from NexusMods
[*]Unzip the file
[*]Paste the folder into your Mods folder
[*]Ensure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url]﻿ installed

[/list]
[b]Compatibility

[/b]No known compatibilty issues.
